The '''Emperor's Birthday''' was a celebration on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]]. The [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] on the planet used the number of days remaining until the holiday as a passcode for the rear door.<ref name="UCD">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=rpga/articles/rx20010816s|text=Ultimate Core Dump|int=Ultimate Core Dump}}</ref>
